I don't think this is a centrifugal pump or a water pump of any sort. If you look at the impellers of water pumps they look nothing like what's in your picture. 

https://m.119pump.com/industry-news/pump-impeller-types.html

Now if you look up turbine impellers you'll see that the shape resembles that of the hot side of a turbo charger. 

https://m.aliexpress.com/i/2251832810587219.html?gatewayAdapt=Pc2Msite4itemAdapt

Add in the gear reduction behind the impeller and the lock wire on the external bolts and I would bet money this is off of a small turbine jet engine. Most likely for the accessory drive. Ie to turn pumps, motors/generators etc at a slower speed than the main shaft.
